content_text:
We are on track to meet the Friday deadline, but it will be tight.
I would not want to overpromise — there are still a few blockers we need to resolve.
Could we get a quick sync tomorrow morning to align on the remaining tasks?
I have already flagged the dependency issue to the client, so we should be covered on that front.
Overall, I am cautiously optimistic, but we need to stay focused this week.
